auth.description:
To obtain your Access Key, follow these steps:

1. Login to Vtiger CRM:
Open a web browser and log in to your Vtiger CRM instance.

2. Navigate to User Profile:
In the top right corner, click on your profile name.
Select "My Preferences."

3. The system will generate an access key for you.
Copy and securely store the access key. This key will be used for authentication when making API requests.
Note:

Access keys are sensitive information, and they should be kept secure.
Treat the access key like a password. Do not share it publicly or expose it in an insecure manner.

instance_url.description: For the instance URL, add the url without the endpoint. For example enter https://<instance>.od2.vtiger.com instead of https://<instance>.od2.vtiger.com/restapi/v1/vtiger/default

record.description: Add new fields to be created in the new record

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new record of a given Vtiger module (element type, e.g. Contacts, Leads, Accounts) with the supplied field values. Choose this to add a new CRM entity. Each call inserts a new record, so repeated calls create duplicates.

record.description: Add new fields to be created in the new record

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves a single Vtiger record by its id within a given module (element type). Choose this when you already have the record id and need its current field values. Read-only and idempotent.

record.description: Add new fields to be created in the new record

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing Vtiger record, identified by its id within a given module (element type), with the supplied field values. Choose this to modify a known record. Idempotent: re-running with the same fields leaves the record in the same state.

record.description: Add new fields to be created in the new record

aiMetadata.description: Deletes a Vtiger record by its id within a given module (element type). Choose this to remove a known record. Idempotent in effect: once deleted, repeating the call leaves the record absent.

query.description: Enter the query statement, e.g. SELECT count(*) FROM Contacts;

aiMetadata.description: Runs a Vtiger VTQL/SQL-style read query (e.g. SELECT ... FROM Contacts) and returns matching records or aggregates such as count(*). Choose this when you need a custom filtered read with full control over columns, conditions, and limit rather than the simpler field-match Search. Read-only and idempotent.

limit.description: Enter the maximum number of records to return.

aiMetadata.description: Searches a Vtiger module (element type) by filtering its records against field-value criteria; string fields match case-insensitive substrings and other fields match exactly. Leaving the criteria empty returns all records (optionally capped by limit). Choose this for simple field-based lookups; use Query Records for custom SQL-style conditions. Read-only and idempotent.

make_api_call.name: make_api_call
make_api_call.description: Performs an arbitrary authorized API call. (Deprecated)

method.description: Select the HTTP method you want to use

url.description: Absolute URL or path. If a relative path is provided (e.g., /me, /listtypes, /describe), it will be called against the REST base.

urlPath.description: Deprecated. Use 'URL' instead. API endpoint's URL path (example: /me, /listtypes, /describe)

headers.description: Enter the desired request headers. Skip the authorization headers

data.description: Enter the data to pass. if its POST, it will be sent as body data, and if GET, as query string

aiMetadata.description: Deprecated. Makes an arbitrary authenticated HTTP call to the Vtiger API, routing to either the legacy webservice.php endpoint or the REST base depending on the URL given. Prefer the dedicated record/query actions; reach for this only for endpoints they do not cover. Idempotency depends on the method and operation invoked, so treat write calls as non-idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
